latin: Simplicitas primi et omnimoda immaterialitas probari non potest per causalitatem efficientem motus, sed per finalem tantum.
translation: The simplicity of the first [being] and its complete immateriality cannot be proved through the efficient causality of motion, but only through final [causality].
